reason: I run everything in Excel and Telegram and it works well enough, and I have never paid for a CRM. 89 dollars a month is a lot for me when my sheet costs nothing.
objection: Moving my data from Excel and Telegram chats will take weeks, and nobody does it for me. Meanwhile I pay 89 dollars a month for a tool my staff may not even use.
would_change_my_mind: Free done-for-you import of my Excel clients and a long free trial where my team works inside Telegram, with a price near 30 dollars a month.
